description: This PHP class provides functions for managing file security, including creating .htaccess files with specific security directives, and handling access restrictions in Drupal projects.

classes.name: FileSecurity
classes.description: Provides file security functions such as writing .htaccess files and setting access restrictions.

methods.name: writeHtaccess
methods.description: Creates or overwrites an .htaccess file in a specified directory with security directives.

methods.name: htaccessLines
methods.description: Generates standard .htaccess lines for private or public directories.

methods.name: htaccessPreventExecution
methods.description: Returns directives to prevent script execution in a directory.

methods.name: denyPublicAccess
methods.description: Returns directives to block all access to a directory.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes contents to a specified file, optionally forcing overwrite.
